title: TradingView Stock & Indicator Scraper Input
description: Configure specific stock symbols, historical OHLCV interval, bar count/date range, and technical indicators to scrape from TradingView.

symbols.title: Stock / Ticker Symbols
symbols.description: Targeted list of specific stocks or tickers to scrape (e.g. "NASDAQ:AAPL", "NYSE:TSLA", "NVDA", "BINANCE:BTCUSDT"). Passing EXCHANGE:SYMBOL avoids ambiguity.

interval.title: Timeframe Interval
interval.description: Candlestick bar interval for historical OHLCV data, per-bar indicators, and TradingView Scanner snapshot.

barsCount.title: Historical Bars Count
barsCount.description: Number of historical OHLCV bars to return per symbol (oldest to newest). Warmup bars are fetched automatically before this window so indicators like EMA200/RSI/MACD are accurate from bar #1.

indicators.title: Per-Bar Technical Indicators
indicators.description: Technical indicators to compute and attach to every historical OHLCV bar. Allowed values: RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, BB, STOCH, ATR, ADX, VWAP, OBV, CCI, ROC, SMC.

indicatorParams.title: Indicator Parameters
indicatorParams.description: Customize periods and multipliers for per-bar indicators (RSI, MACD, EMA/SMA periods, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, ATR, ADX, CCI, ROC).

includeHistoricalBars.title: Include Historical OHLCV Bars
includeHistoricalBars.description: Fetch historical OHLCV bars via TradingView Chart WebSocket.

includePerBarIndicators.title: Attach Indicators to Each Historical Bar
includePerBarIndicators.description: Compute and attach the selected technical indicators onto each historical bar.

includeScannerSnapshot.title: Include TradingView Scanner TA Snapshot
includeScannerSnapshot.description: Fetch TradingView's live Scanner technical analysis snapshot (recommendations, RSI, MACD, Moving Averages, fundamentals) for the chosen interval.

searchType.title: Symbol Resolution Asset Type
searchType.description: Used when bare tickers (without EXCHANGE:) are passed in symbols.

preferredExchanges.title: Preferred Exchanges
preferredExchanges.description: Exchange priority order when resolving bare tickers like "AAPL" without an exchange prefix.

session.title: Trading Session
session.description: Regular market hours or extended (pre-market + after-hours) session for historical bars.

adjustment.title: Price Adjustment
adjustment.description: Adjust historical prices for splits or dividends.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of symbols scraped concurrently.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout per request/WebSocket session in milliseconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy or custom proxy configuration.
